item.title: Ntsc-rs – open-source video emulation of analog TV and VHS artifacts
item.description:
📝 ntsc-rs is a free, open-source video effect which accurately emulates analog TV and VHS artifacts. ntsc-rs uses algorithms that model how NTSC transmission and VHS encoding actually work, based on algorithms developed in composite-video-simulator, zhuker/ntsc, and ntscQT. This includes DaVinci Resolve, Hitfilm, and Vegas.
🔗 Read more: https://ntsc.rs/
